2026-10-23-63.title: To-dos and Meetings
2026-10-23-63.body: The Tasks tab now holds two lists: To-dos and Meetings. A to-do is what Madar called a task before. In a project, the tab is To-dos.

2026-10-23-62.title: Show one kind of chat
2026-10-23-62.body: Next to the chat search, pick All, Projects, To-dos or People. People shows direct chats and groups.

2026-10-23-61.title: Satellite view on the maps
2026-10-23-61.body: Press Satellite in the corner of a map to see the site from above. Press Street map to go back. Madar keeps your choice.

2026-10-23-60.title: Cleaner sub-company logos
2026-10-23-60.body: The small logo of a sub-company on a project picture now sits in a clean gap, with no dark or white ring around it.
